high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from Brett Adcock (@adcock_brett) on X (formerly Twitter). The tweet announces the launch of DeepSeek V3.1, an updated hybrid reasoner by DeepSeek. The tweet highlights that DeepSeek V3.1 reaches answers faster than its predecessor, DeepSeek-R1-0528, and promises stronger performance in tool use and multi-step agent tasks.
